titulo: Just the first one, inside their ten
caption:
Just the first one, inside their ten

"I have ten minutes." "Just the first one." She circled the first line on the plan, and it got done inside the ten.

Fitting the ask to the minutes they have is kinder than a full list, and the first item still gets done.

For whoever fits the ask to the minutes the other person has.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table. At the right a paper titled Plan with three lines and a small clock sign that says 10 min above it. A royal blue block figure with narrowed eyes says I have ten minutes. A ink-black block figure with white eyes answers just the first one, a red circle is drawn around the first line of the plan and its box ticks, with a small sparkle. The blue one's eyes go wide and says ...great. thanks! Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me fitting it to their ten.
